name: Clearing Broker Identification
definition: Reference number assigned by the clearing broker. A distinction can be made between the reference for the Central Counterparty (CCP) leg and the reference for the client leg of the transaction.

SideIndicator.name: Side Indicator
SideIndicator.definition: Distinguishes the client leg from the central counterpatry (CCP) leg in the clearing broker identification.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification assigned by the clearing broker.

RelatedTradeIdentification.name: Related Trade Identification
RelatedTradeIdentification.definition: Other identifications of a trade for which clearing broker identifications are provided.
